tags.description: Stored tags, including provenance when supplied. An empty map is returned as an empty array. Existing creatives keep their original tags.

CreativeIntakeTags.description: Optional flat map of at most 32 string tags; reserved keys count toward the cap. For a creative from an outside tool, set generator and generator_job, plus parent_creative for a variation. Values are stored unchanged. PlainRouter’s own creative tools will set these on every creative they make; intake performs no generation, rendering or scoring.

generator.description: Lowercase slug naming the outside tool that made the creative.

generator_job.description: Printable characters naming the tool’s job or render; control and other non-printable characters are refused.

parent_creative.description: The id returned by the creative APIs: a lowercase ULID of an existing creative in the same workspace that this creative varies.
